title: Obsidian & Crying Obsidian Expansion
description: Expand your Obsidian and Crying Obsidian builds with stairs, slabs, fences, doors, trapdoors, panes, pressure plates, rods, and glowing Crying Obsidian variants!
body:
# 🟪 Obsidian & Crying Obsidian Expansion

Take your dark, powerful, and Nether-inspired builds to the next level!  
**Obsidian & Crying Obsidian Expansion** adds a full set of new building blocks for both **Obsidian** and **Crying Obsidian**, giving builders way more freedom when creating strong, mysterious, or magical structures.

No more being limited to basic blocks — now you can finally build with obsidian in more detailed shapes and styles! 🧱✨

---

## ✨ What does this mod add?

This mod expands Obsidian with new decorative and functional variants:

- 🪜 **Obsidian Stairs**
- 🧱 **Obsidian Slabs**
- 🚧 **Obsidian Fences**
- 🔘 **Obsidian Buttons**
- 🚪 **Obsidian Doors**
- 🪟 **Obsidian Panes**
- 🪤 **Obsidian Trapdoors**
- ⚖️ **Obsidian Pressure Plates**
- 🟣 **Obsidian Rods**

And the best part:

## 💜 Crying Obsidian Variants Included!

Every added Obsidian block also has a **Crying Obsidian** version!

That means you can create glowing, mysterious, and magical-looking builds using the same block types, but with the unique Crying Obsidian style. 🌌

---

## 🌙 Glowing Crying Obsidian

Crying Obsidian variants glow in the dark, making them perfect for:

- 🏰 Nether castles
- 🕳️ Dark portals
- 🛕 Ancient ruins
- 🔮 Magical builds
- 🌋 Nether bases
- 👑 Strong fantasy structures

They add atmosphere without needing tons of extra lighting blocks.

---

## 🏗️ Perfect For Builders

This mod is great for players who love:

- Vanilla-friendly building
- Dark fantasy structures
- Nether-themed bases
- Strong fortress designs
- Decorative block variety
- Obsidian and Crying Obsidian aesthetics

Whether you're building a portal room, a fortress, a dungeon, or a mysterious shrine, this mod gives you the missing pieces you always wanted.

---

## ✅ Simple, Clean & Vanilla-Friendly

Obsidian & Crying Obsidian Expansion keeps things simple:

- No complicated systems
- No overpowered mechanics
- Just useful new building blocks
- Works great in survival and creative
- Perfect for modpacks and vanilla+ gameplay

---

## 🧡 Build Stronger. Build Darker. Build Better.

Expand your obsidian builds with new shapes, new details, and glowing Crying Obsidian variants.

Make your builds look stronger, darker, and more unique than ever before! 🟪🔥
